task.description: Validate test design and integration test implementation for ISS-104. Verify complete coverage, isolation, and self-sufficiency before TEST-RUNNER execution.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement has an integration test
All fixtures isolated with per-test UUIDs
Cleanup is automatic (defer blocks) and comprehensive
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent

result.summary: ISS-104 test design validation complete. All 4 MUST test cases present with comprehensive coverage, per-test UUID fixtures, automatic cleanup, and real PostgreSQL integration. Hard gate requirements satisfied. Ready for TEST-RUNNER (Step 4).
